title: Froggy's Adventures Demo
description: Play the free opening chapter of Froggy's Adventures! Create your own frog and explore cozy Lilypad City — recover the stolen Golden Fly, brave the pitch-dark Mossy Caverns for the sunken crown, and drive back the Oozing to become a hero. About 20 minutes. Wishlist the full 5-chapter adventure!

title: Lost Galaxy: Survivors Demo
description: Defend massive interdimensional portals against relentless alien swarms in this fast-paced sci-fi top-down survival shooter.

title: ChompBurg Demo
description: Control an acolyte of Dracula through the mazeburg, collecting villagers and avoiding the hunters to break the score, customize power ups to trigger your combos and become the hunter, transform Chompburg into a point making machine and discover dopamine blasting synergies!

title: Blek and the Endless Keep Demo
description: Guide Blek through the twisting grey halls of the Endless Keep as they work to get their memories back! Fight back the Keep's monstrous spawn, meet it's unique denizens, and make thorough use of the art of cat necromancy to find your way back home! The Keep can't truly be Endless, can it?

title: 漂流工厂 Demo
description: Gather resources, research technologies, expand platforms, and build conveyor belt networks to survive and thrive in a perilous maritime world. Utilize automated production lines to free up manual labor, keep the factory running continuously, and ultimately build a starship to travel to Mars.

title: Problem Space Demo
description: Venture forth through this puzzle game across space. Use your command terminal to guide the Onlooker interstellar probe through treacherous galaxies to explore the farthest reaches of the universe. Avoid asteroids, perform research tasks, and weave through the stars!

title: Sharp Stock Demo
description: Local game asset manager for developers and artists. Preview 3D models, Spine animations, audio, images, and fonts; pack texture atlases, split sprite sheets, search with tags, and work 100% on your own disk.

title: CRANE GAME QUEST DEMO
description: A simulation game that recreates the Japanese crane game experience. Feel the frustration of the arcade right at home. Use a variety of techniques to win prizes. Unlock prizes and stages as you master the crane game.

title: New Science Demo
description: What if you could rediscover everything humanity has ever invented?New Science is a card combination game that takes you from the Stone Age to the Age of Intelligence, one discovery at a time.Start with the basics. Combine them to make something new. Combine that with something else. Watch history unfold in your hands.

title: 大剑25k：邪恶入侵 Demo
description: This game is an action-adventure game. Your goal is to eliminate all visible alien creatures. You can use shields and sword skills, with two different types of moves. You can parry and killing enemies can restore some stats. Continuous killing is the only way to keep you alive.

title: Kings Call 2 Demo
description: Become the Lord of Silver Heron Ridge in Kings Call 2. Collect cards to summon creatures, cast spells and defeat monsters. Four classes: Mage for area damage, Priest with Holy Light, Ranger for precision, Warrior boosting team power. Cards from White to Gold. Test your strategy and courage!

title: Very Disco, Disco Very! Demo
description: Everyone locks in moves at once, then the simulation takes over. A dense, chaotic programming game for 1 to 8 players where pushes, cards, and chain reactions ensure nothing goes as intended.

title: Golfcremental Demo
description: BUILD! GOLF! EARN! BUY! Turn $50 into your own golfing empire by building custom golf courses and then automating them to get hole in ones. Unlock unique golf course pieces and use them in unique ways to make more money.

title: ZodiacLottery Demo
description: A lottery roguelike. Move animals to create winning tickets, then combine powerful synergies and unique relics to build massive jackpots!

title: BLIGHTEN Demo
description: BLIGHTEN is a survival horror fps set in an abandoned facility overrun by mindless creatures infected by the Blight. Scavenge for resources and do whatever it takes to survive the industrial hellscape you're isolated within.

title: Seagull Lighthouse Demo
description: In a lighthouse, you read letters, write back, and wait. Only a sea, a flock of seagulls that deliver bottles, and bottles that drift in from nowhere, carrying the lives of strangers inside. Your replies may shape their stories. In an age of anxiety and speed, let yourself slow down.

title: Neural Descent Demo
description: A platformer with a twist

title: House Of Trauma Demo
description: Gabriel, a cps worker, has been trapped inside a psychotic mother's house. Will he ESCAPE!?This is a shortened demo meant to be a teaser for the full game, House of Trauma, releasing Halloween of 2026.

title: Super Magic Ball ! Home Run Derby Demo
Sokobomb Demo
description: Sokobomb is a puzzle game about blowing things up to find your way forward.

title: Blob of Ink Demo
description: Blob of Ink is a short incremental game where you grow a tiny living ink blob into something greater.Consume letters, unlock magic powers, gather ink, and evolve into your final form.UNIQUE SKILLSWords are only the beginning - face their living incarnations and consume them.

title: Corefall: Idle Dungeon RPG Demo
description: Assemble a party of heroes, descend into a living 3D dungeon, and watch them fight. A deep idle RPG with TONS of ENDLESS Content!

title: Conquer for Glory Demo
description: A side-on strategy game about raising armies and conquering a dark fantasy world. Lead one of eight races, break the enemy line with troops, monsters and unique abilities, and take the map kingdom by kingdom.

title: Thrice-a-dice Demo
description: Trice-a-Dice is a roguelike Dice-Builder. Roll dice to earn money. Raplace dice faces for better ones and combine into the best. Buy Cats to create synergies with faces and upgrades. Deal with the Devil, gamble in slot machine and buy Angel's help. All of this just to pay to play further.

title: Nicu Ștefan Cristian's Mongol 2 Demo
description: Story:You are food. You've always been food. You came onto this world to be consumed, to be devoured by your primordial creators. How unfortunate that you learnt about it at the end of the times, the Ante-Diotoromus. But not all is lost.

title: Aevalore Demo
description: No dialogue. No filler. Just chaos. Choose a hero, master their 81 skill combinations, survive the 10-minute horde across deadly maps. With 300,000+ build combinations, how will you survive? Level up, play your cards right, and conquer the bosses. AEVALORE: Your hero, your build, YOUR CHOICE.

title: The Dark Forest Calls Demo
description: Explore an isolated village swallowed by darkness and fog. Search for supplies, manage limited resources, use light carefully, and survive a slow-burn first-person horror experience where every sound can matter.

title: Stellar Harvest Demo
description: Play the opening of Stellar Harvest for free. Build your planetary energy empire, experience your first prestige, and begin the journey toward constructing a Dyson Sphere.

title: Silly Typing Game Demo
description: A lightning-fast typing roguelike where vocabulary meets high-octane arcade survival. Adapt to shifting HUDs, chaotic bosses, and brutal viruses across procedural runs. But beware: the more efficiently you type, the closer the interface looks back at you.

title: Uptime: A Cloud Provider Sim Demo
description: Build a cloud provider from a garage to a hyperscaler - rack the hardware, run every cable, route the traffic, keep customers online. A first-person infrastructure sim where ports, power, fault domains, RSTP and BGP do real work, not flavour text. Readable for newcomers, honest for engineers.

title: SLANT Demo
description: A 2D puzzle platformer game where you reach the goal point by overcoming various traps and puzzles.

title: Tiny Towers Demo
description: A short incremental game about defending your tiny fortress from hordes of tiny mobs. Place towers, gain resources by defeating enemies, and unlock new upgrades in the skill tree to strengthen your goblin stronghold.

title: System Cleaner Demo
description: Bullet heaven meets base building. System Cleaner is a survivorslike set inside a broken computer, where you fight corrupted files and place helpful buildings as you go. Clean up waves of glitches your way: dodge and shoot through the chaos, or build a growing setup that does the work for you.

title: Snake: Gridbreaker Demo
description: Play the first loop of Snake: Gridbreaker. Defeat the Gatekeeper, unlock Ghost Snake, progress Anomaly Signal, and carry your save into the full game.

title: DUSK OF WAR Demo
description: DUSK OF WAR is an idle clicker incremental war management game. As the WAR MINISTER, you are in charge of the army, the industry, the finances and the logistics. PROTECT YOUR COUNTRY TODAY!

title: Flat Mars Demo
description: Flat Mars is an action roguelike FPS. Shoot your way through millions of demons and tear through the terrain with an arsenal of futuristic weapons to claim powerful relics.

title: Ultimate Wizard Demo
description: Destroy thousands of enemies and grow in power in this fantasy roguelite survivor. Find spells and augment them, equip build defining items, discover secrets, level up and set out to become the ultimate wizard!

title: At Face Value Demo
description: Every card is worth exactly what it says, so draw a few thousand of them. At Face Value is a witty, deceptively deep incremental about turning one humble deck of cards into a runaway point-printing machine. Draw, upgrade, shuffle, repeat… just one more time.

title: UnderWorldMonstersPinball Demo
description: Introducing *Underworld Monsters Pinball*, a fresh take on pinball where you aim for high scores with a cast of quirky monster characters riding the ball! Hone your skills and aim for your personal best score!

title: Edicts of the Truthsinger: The Orb of Artemagus Demo
description: Six witnesses, six suspects, and thousands of discoverable lines of dialog. You're the fantasy detective on the case of a stolen magical artifact, and in order to determine the truth you'll have to cross examine, interrogate, and reference all your resources to catch the thief before time runs out.

title: Re:collect Demo
description: In a postwar world where even memories can be used as collateral, you become the owner of a small pawnshop. Speak with customers, judge the value of their memories and belongings, and over 30 days of running the shop, uncover forgotten truths and the story of the protagonist.

title: Escape From Ashville Demo
description: Loot, fight and extract — or lose everything. A high-risk extraction shooter focused on survival, tactical combat, and meaningful decisions.

title: Son of Beach Demo
description: Start as a Beach Caretaker Intern. Clean up trash left behind by tourists and recycle it to unlock powerful new tools. Follow the changing tides to dig up hidden treasures beneath the sand. Catch seafood, run your own seafood stand, and sell rare coastal collectibles in your treasure shop.

title: UpDown&Shot Demo
description: Load the revolver and guess the dealer's number. Wrong? Then put the barrel to your head and pull the trigger.

title: Paironix Demo
description: A fast-paced, rogue-like tile-matching adventure! Connect identical pairs to unleash powerful magic spells, adapt to shifting grids, and draft game-changing upgrades. Can you survive the ever-evolving trials in this striking minimalist vector world?

title: Mercenary Brotherhood Demo
description: A deep turn‑based tactics RPG featuring emergent stories, procedural world events, enemy factions, magical loot with drawbacks, and a fully simulated fantasy sandbox. Build your mercenary company, survive brutal battles, and uncover new content. Solo‑dev indie project with active development.

title: Huiyu AI Trip Demo
description: Huiyu AI Trip is an interactive travel experience — a visual journey you can control. Hold W/D to move forward through the scene, hold S/A to rewind time backwards, release to pause. flicker-free forward and reverse playback.

title: Escape Them Demo
description: A silent stealth horror game. No weapons, no power just hiding spots, tricks, and nerve. Find the key, escape the house, and don't let them hear you

title: Teen Hustler Demo
description: Build your digital empire from a cramped room to a high-tech penthouse. Code, hack, mine crypto, and manipulate the dark web in this deep 3D economic sandbox simulator. Stay in the shadows, manage your hardware, and don't get caught by the police!

title: A Vessel of Frustration Demo
description: You return to your hometown but no one recognizes you. But that doesn’t matter, because you are not here for them. You are here for her. Midgårdsormen, singer and artist, pervert and goddess, a being truly out of this world.

title: Leukocyte Demo
description: Action-adventure game for solo play or with friends. Fight viruses and bacteria, gain DNA mutations, and develop new abilities as you explore the human body and face challenging bosses.

title: Capy Farm Demo
description: A short incremental game where you build a farm run entirely by capybaras. Expand your fields, automate production, earn massive profits, and outperform rival farms to win the Grand Harvest Competition.

title: Voxel Breakers Demo
description: Voxel Breakers - a relaxing incremental game where you break voxels, buy and upgrade breaker robots, then watch them break voxels for you faster and faster.

title: Cleanup Crew Demo
description: A space station has gone dark and its captive alien specimens are loose. Fight through procedurally generated rooms, solve each planet's terminal puzzle, and unlock new weapons as you clear three hostile worlds in this 2D roguelite.

title: Crop and Claw 2 Demo
description: Crop and Claw 2 is an Adventure-RPG about dragons, plants, memories, and more. Delve into a whole new continent of secrets and unearth the roots of the strange events going on.

title: SwipSwap Demo
description: You are about to enter Dracoulous' Castle. And for what? A hefty price on his head! Countless minions, bosses and traps stand between you and him.. As a Shadow Dancer, you will have to coordinate with your duo, the shade. Use it to your advantage:### Combine your Dash and your Swip/Swap to overcome Bosses!

title: Climbing Simplified Demo
description: A minimalist physics-based climbing puzzle game where every move matters. Plan your moves, manage stamina, and master different climbing disciplines. The demo will include 20 routes within the first two environments: Gym and Granite.

title: Inimigo - The Warrior Saint Versus the God of Discord- Demo
description: Is one the villain and the other the hero? The truth is more complicated than that. Discover the story between two enemies in this dark fantasy BL visual novel!

title: Derples Vs Xenos Demo
description: DEMO . Lead a squad of Derples in a desperate fight for survival amid abandoned colonial outposts. Build defences, explore dark un-powered rooms, scavenge for resources, fight turn based battles in an alien-infested hellscape. Solo only for Demo (4-player co-op for the full game). Coming soon!

title: Ultimate Guess Game Demo
description: Ultimate Guess Game is a thrilling digital social game. Challenge a friend and race to identify the mystery image you are holding using strategic "Yes/No" questions. With diverse categories to choose from, use your deduction skills to win! Can you solve the puzzle before your opponent does?

title: Little Battle Simulator
description: Create the battlefield of your dreams and fight! Monsters, vast armies, rivers and forests, multiple teams… Anything goes! Create your own battle in "Sandbox". Witness the chaos in "Random Battle", Achieve the highest possible score in "Challenge"

title: Droning On Demo
description: Write code that looks and feels just like Python to guide Gizmo through the first 10 Bootcamp levels. A free taste of the full game, where puzzles and procedural runs push you, and your code, to the limit.

title: Dont Bust Demo
description: The BlackJack rogelike, Don't Bust is a fast paced take at blackjack, collect your augments, drink your Neon Shots and try not to bust.

title: SPER Apocalypse Demo
description: A dark survival RPG set in a post-apocalyptic world where a mysterious virus has changed humanity forever. Fight to survive, uncover the truth, and face the consequences of infection.

title: Escape from Umbra Demo
description: Immerse yourself in a survival horror escape room experience. Trapped in a mysterious world of darkness where shadows lurk, your only help is a secret book and a flashlight. Solve the enigmas and move unseen to escape Umbra’s domain.

title: Wizard Magic DEMO
description: An autistic wizard and their ADHD familiar go on the adventure of a lifetime. Make strange friends, battle wizards and monsters, and explore the magical city of Bizzaire in this bite-sized pixel-art RPG!

title: Seek Shellter Demo
description: Seek Shellter is an arcade-style pathfinder full of cute snails who must collect batteries and seek shelter before the timer runs out. Team up with a friend or go solo to clear levels, win minigames and unlock worlds steeped in retro-60s atomic charm. Do you have what it takes to beat the bomb?

title: Mr. Grin's Final Act Demo
description: Thirty years ago, a tragedy silenced the studio. You are back... So is Mr. Grin. In this first-person survival horror, scavenge old badges, rewire circuits, crack safes. Stay out of sight. One sound and you die. He's not only hunting you. His script. Your survival.

title: Aster League: 2179 Demo
description: Aster League: 2179 is a kart racing spinoff to the small vehicles content of BallisticNG. Boost is king, and piloting in a straight line is a sure-fire way to lose the race.

title: Swamptender Demo
description: A fast-paced retro action game DEMO where you serve weaponized drinks to waves of hostile swamp creatures, defend your bar, and survive the night in a Game Boy–inspired experience.

title: Akaneiro ni Somaru Saka Demo
description: Nagase Junichi's life takes an unexpected turn when his fiancée, Katagiri Yuuhi transfers to his school but what would be a happy reunion crumbles due to a misunderstanding. Will this be an end to Junichi's formally peaceful, school life?

title: Nightmare Raid: Blood Card Storm Demo
description: Enter the dungeon and unleash devastating card combos in Nightmare Raid: Blood Card Storm. Build powerful decks, trigger explosive chain effects, evolve weapons, and survive endless monster waves in this fast-paced roguelike card adventure.

title: Tetra Rise Demo
description: Defeat countless enemies and escape the abyss! Tetra Rise is an action-platformer with roguelite elements, where you upgrade your equipment and face ever-growing hordes as you climb toward the surface.

title: Dark Spawn: Infestation Demo
description: Dark Spawn: Infestation is a horror adventure game set in a Victorian-era inspired research facility. The protagonist got abducted by evil scientists, and has to solve puzzles and avoid strange creatures to escape.

title: Outspin Champions Demo
description: Outspin Champions is a competitive PvP brawler where the spinning never stops. Blending party game chaos with souls-like precision, master physics-driven weapon weight to deflect foes. Outspin. Outsmart. Outlast.

title: Cold Sweat Demo
description: Cold Sweat is a PvE single player extraction shooter set in a post-apocalyptic world. Collect loot, complete missions for traders, upgrade your base, customize your firearms, and shoot your way through other survivors and the undead.

title: Drift Mania
description: No brakes. No reverse. Just drift control. Master short precision courses, chase ghosts and leaderboards, build custom tracks, and turn messy attempts into clean time-attack runs.

title: Hover Raid Demo
description: Hover, raid, upgrade. Eliminate thousands of zombies, unlock devastating abilities, and grow stronger with every run in this incremental action game. This is a short demo that lets you try out 9 of the 17 skills.

title: Flexible Frosty Demo
description: A short and icy GameBoy-style puzzle platformer featuring Frosty, a cute little penguin who can not jump like other penguins.

title: FLASK Demo
description: FLASK is a roguelike autobattler about alchemical greed on the new frontier. Build unstoppable homunculi, barter with mutated merchants, and slay hordes of monsters to harvest their valuable blood. It's time to get bloody... Bloody rich!

title: Gnat Pack Demo
description: A short incremental game about feeding a swarm of hungry gnats. Guide your bugs to the fruit, and unlock upgrades to grow your pack of buzzing buddies one bite at a time.

title: Farm Bang Demo
description: Raise living ammo, blast monsters, haul massive loot, and survive the debt collectors in this chaotic top-down farming shooter.

title: A Simple Square Demo
description: A Simple Square is a minimalist puzzle game where every move changes the level. Slide in straight lines, erase the tiles behind you, plan your path, and reach the exit without trapping yourself.

title: Loopstructor 2: Skyspine Demo
description: Build intricate rail networks, deploy and upgrade unique Battle Trains, and harness Turret Enchantments to forge mobile fortresses. Fend off endless abominations from the deep earth. Every layout is a battle of wits, every adjustment decides survival.

title: Next Star Demo
description: Idol Talent Show Simulation Game-Train from zero to idol debut! Rank high to stay in! Explore the map, manage your schedule and play mini-games.Face tough evaluations,compete with fellow trainees, and forge meaningful bonds. Your choices will unlock 10+ unique endings. Can you shine?

title: Speff Demo
description: Run, jump, and THINK your way through a series of grisly obstacles and diabolical puzzles. 20 Levels across 5 hubs with a range of hand drawn environments.

title: Emotional Labor Laboratory Demo
description: [Free Demo]Dive into virtual world and play emotions alongside your quirky, beautiful boss. A unique kind of 'Emotional Labor' begins, blending sweet chemistry with electrifying rhythm action.

title: ConOps21: Subversion Protocol – Book One: Black Signal Demo Slice
description: You are Cipher Reeve. The Dominion tried to erase you. The protocol failed. Enter the opening signal of ConOps21: Subversion Protocol — Book One: Black Signal, an interactive cinematic demo slice set in Neo-London. Memory is the terrain. Truth is contraband. Free.

title: The Rich Die First Demo
description: Build wealth, outsmart your rivals, and become the last millionaire standing in this multiplayer strategy card game. Play against friends or challenge AI opponents in a battle for financial dominance.

title: Von Neumann Project Demo
description: In this demo of Von Neumann Project you play as a self replicating probe as it charts the galaxies, peacefully, of course. Mine, build, expand, and explore in this sci-fi RTS. Remember to have as little impact on your surroundings as possible and protect yourself at all costs.

title: Bottled by Bears Demo
description: Join a family of bears and run the buzziest little honey farm! Collect and discover rare bees, bottle honey jars, expand your farm, and watch your flowery field bloom in this cozy idle management game.

title: FIGHTERIZER Demo
description: FIGHTERIZERA free-movement 3D fighting game set inside a globe-spanning illegal tournament where every hit counts, every angle matters, and every fighter brings their own way to win.This isn’t a traditional 2D lane fighter.

title: Guilty As Charged! Demo
description: Set in a dystopian world where even small crimes are punished in permanence, Guilty As Charged! sees 20-year-old Alan Pierce fight for victory in a televised gameshow between 18 criminals where the winner not only keeps their life, but gains a huge cash prize – as well as their freedom.

title: warp train Demo
description: Board a time-bending train and raid dangerous top-down extraction zones. Scavenge loot, smash buildings, reshape terrain, fight monster swarms, and escape before time runs out. Mix weapon affixes with magic stones to create your own explosive farming build.

title: 丢丢 Demo
description: 《丢丢》是一款可爱风格的自走棋，所有攻击方式均为把手里的物品丢出去，难度很轻松，失败了没惩罚还有奖励？

title: Stigmata Demo
description: Stigmata is a classic survival horror experience where you must fight, explore, and manage your resources to survive. A man finds himself alone in a city where reality is beginning to unfold. Step into the confession booth and face the one who watches. Does judgement await you or something else?

title: Prison Chain: The Unredeemed Thought Demo
description: Try the demo of Prison Chain: The Unredeemed Thought — a psychological suspense visual novel about sin and redemption. You wake up in an unfamiliar living room. Two silent men stand beside you. Every choice changes their "sin value" and leads to a different ending.

title: Castleborne Survivors Demo
description: A survivors-like game with side-scrolling action combat. Slash, dodge, and mow down endless monsters in a gothic horror castle. Upgrade with every choice, snowball out of control, and survive until the very end.

title: Rally King Demo
description: Rally King is a casino-themed ping pong roguelike where every rally puts the pot on the line. Play solo or with up to 3 friends. Hit chips, collect cards, roll dice, stack multipliers, and build broken paddle combos before one bad shot wipes it all.

title: Echoes of Memory Demo
description: Explore an abandoned mountain village, investigate mysterious audio tapes, and confront memories that contradict the truth. A dark psychological horror mystery in anime style.

title: Dice of Soul：刹那の裁定 Demo
落幕之前 Before the Fall Demo
description: 世纪交接的十年，港岛。一笔意外的投资让初出茅庐的剧作家姜韶平得以将首作搬上剧院舞台。这看似天降的机遇，却早已在暗中标好了筹码——渐行渐远的旧友、少时仰望的偶像、意外相识的神秘乐手、避而不见的至亲……谁能成为你的缪斯？谁又会将你推向深渊？亦或是，当掌声渐息，帷幕落下，还留在舞台上的，只有自己……

title: ai.ai Demo
description: The CEO of ai.ai has passed away, and his final word was "bubble." Uncover the meaning of his final word in this comedy mystery satirizing Silicon Valley. From the creator of the Jenkins webcomic.

title: Elude Demo
description: We took the weirdest yet most oddly-satisfying in-engine physics behaviours and made the best platformer experience we could.  Climb, evade or 'physics trick' your way through this deceptively simple coop platformer!

title: Figryne Cast Studio Engine Demo
description: An all-in-one VTuber streaming studio that tracks your VRM avatar in real time and takes you live. Its 3D-native engine brings cinematic post-FX and Axis 3D depth, and you can stream straight to YouTube, Twitch, and any RTMP-compatible service. No OBS needed. Buy once and use it forever.

title: Quasar Demo
description: Quasar is a "Bullet Hell Space Opera" with endless levels and upgrades for your ship. You'll fight against squadrons of enemy ships, even battling entire armadas, with bosses appearing occasionally during Survival mode.

title: Dracanea: The Ragtag Regalia PREVIEW Demo
description: Dracanea: The Ragtag Regalia is a comedy adventure game where Riker, an ex-teen hero, now lives life as a fully grown, slightly washed-up celebrity. Solve puzzles in the overworld to collect items, engage in turn-based battles with fighting-game button inputs, and even learn 150+ cooking recipes!

title: Seasonaut Demo
description: Explore a world divided among the four seasons, help its inhabitants, and solve the problems of each region. What begins as simple tasks soon transforms into a journey of discovery, mystery, and decisions that shape the future of this universe.

title: SkyMine Demo
description: Start digging, discover valuable resources, and uncover the secrets of surviving among the mines. This game combines strategy and creativity, offering an exciting experience.

title: PAGANS Demo
description: PAGANS is a dark-fantasy strategy card game inspired by Slavic mythology. Build a deck of gods, spirits, curses, and warriors, then fight short tactical PvE battles by controlling mystical locations and chaining powerful card synergies.

title: 字趣 Demo
description: 在文字宇宙中，公主被封印。请带她离开这里。多音字、同音字、平翘舌、反义字、成语、诗词，是你的成长技能。开动你的脑筋，走出这文字的迷宫！去解开所有的谜题吧！

title: Cascadium Demo
description: A simple idle game where you drop balls plinko-style to make money. Big number make head go brrrr.

title: Code RAPID Demo
description: Code RAPID is a Third-Person Action Mecha game with the focus on real-time high-mobility movement. Fight on the Ondarean front to uncover mysteries of a forgotten planet. Complete missions to earn weapons and parts to build a mech that truly suits your playstyle with deep customization systems.

title: Affictionate Demo
description: After a year of bad dates and failed job applications, you've nearly given up on the love story you've always written about. One night, you write your perfect man into a notebook... the next day, he becomes a reality. A romance visual novel about identity and the line between fiction and reality.

title: Rahasya:The unsolved mystery Demo
description: RAHASYA is a first-person horror mystery game where you investigate supernatural events, uncover hidden clues, and complete dangerous objectives.

title: Dark Workshop Simulator Demo
description: Dark Workshop is a first-person dark fantasy shop sim. Buy from shady suppliers, craft potions and weapons, set your prices, and sell to orcs, plague doctors, and mercenaries. World events reshape the market - read the signs, prepare during rumors, and profit when chaos hits.

title: Rifted Worlds Demo
description: A fast-paced Action-RPG that takes place on the floating remnants of destroyed worlds. Discover fragments of your lost world, place them onto the map, and explore! It's time to uncover the truth behind your world's destruction...

title: Accept or Reject Demo
description: Review hundreds of bizarre dating profiles, play mini-games, survive office drama, and try to romance your boss in this dating app management comedy.

title: Witch Hunt 0 Demo
description: "Witch Hunt 0" is a magic-focused, stage-based boss rush 3D action game. Take on the role of the witch Astera. To reclaim her lost powers, she must craft spells, tame defeated enemies as familiars, and conquer the formidable foes that stand in her way.

title: KOKO Dungeon Mania Demo
description: KOKO Dungeon Mania is a dungeon crawler adventure where you explore mysterious chambers, solve puzzles, battle monsters, and uncover the path forward. Each new level expands the dungeon with more chambers, tougher enemies, and greater challenges to overcome.

title: Stewart The Fox: Swing it! Demo
description: Master swinging, walljumps, and momentum based movement across 3 handcrafted maps. Improve your personal bests, race against ghosts, and experience a taste of the full game featuring 15+ maps, global leaderboards, clothing unlocks, and more.

title: Satanic Panic Demo
description: SATANIC PANIC is a fantastical strategy tower defense with heavy Roguelike elements. A war has broken out between Heaven and Hell, and Satan himself has entrusted you with a small army of chibi Biblically Accurate Demons to defend the layers of hell against an endless onslaught of Angelic assaults.

title: 程序员的刻板印象 Demo
description: For years, society has held many stereotypes about the programming profession. In this life simulation game, players can experience a programmer's journey from university to career development. Whether a programmer's life truly matches public perception can be discovered by trying it out.

title: Slime Simulator Demo
description: You need to obtain food to survive, and you can transform into the animals you hunt.

title: Boxing Bastards Demo
description: Plunge into a medieval world where knights brawl with their fists rather than swords! Get creative with physics-based combat as you fight through several thematic biomes full of unique enemies and encounters. Complete quests, buy upgrades, and kill baddies to become the ultimate Boxing Bastard!

title: Escape The Humans Demo

description: Comfort Food: A Taste of Courage is a fast-paced, action-packed cooking game. Roast, fry, and sizzle a variety of dishes to complete orders and earn money before rent is due! Embark on this culinary quest of courage as Teal reheats her passion for cooking again!

title: Deep Space Survivor: Endless Starfield Demo
description: "Deep Space Survivor: Endless Starfield" is a survivor-style game. Your interstellar battleship accidentally enters an unknown universe, fighting its way through endless enemies, roaming multiple star systems, and collecting meteor resources to forge your ultimate orbital weapon.

title: Chop Loop Demo
description: A 3D incremental lumberjack game where every tree changes the way you play. Unlock unique tree mechanics, control which trees appear with runes and upgrade beavers to automate your harvest.

title: EvoluCell Demo
description: Free demo—Chapter 1 only (~20–30 min). Shoot, devour, inflammation storm. 3 gene shops, boss Pulseroid. Morphs & more chapters coming. Wishlist EvoluCell!

title: 宽恕我（Show me mercy） Demo
description: SHOWMEMERCY is mystery otomegame. Play as Lilith, a widowedduchess who must eliminate those threaten herself or others. Choose method, plan thecrime. Every decision leads to different outcome. Build relationships with characters— stepson, priest, sheriff,and apothecary. Trust them, or deceive them

title: One Billion Ducks Demo
description: An incremental journey about duck hunting with your canine companions. Shoot rare ducks, sell them, upgrade your abilities, and collect one billion ducks to combat world hunger!

title: Amnesia Bullet Demo
description: A demo for Amnesia Bullet, a TPS shooter with gyro aiming support. Play the opening story, tutorial, and the first Memory stage.

title: Phemx Demo
description: Phemx is a simple but increasingly challenging retro-style arcade game. Use your paddle to bounce the balls to safety and get a big score!

title: Jack Pottwin: House of Odds Demo
description: Fight your way up a casino tower to wake from a fever dream in this Roguelike Deckbuilder. Craft your deck, modify runs with lucky coins, and control the Odds. Fuse cards to build high value attacks, trigger poker combos to add powerful combat traits to your cards.

title: Oro Cade Demo
description: Master ORO CADE, a relaxing 3D logic puzzler. Target color groups to clear the board, but don’t break the chain or blocks will reappear! Demo contains 10 of 70 handcrafted levels, 3 modes of difficulty and a dynamic soundtrack.
